title: Ternary Search
description: Write a Zig program that implements ternary search on a sorted array to find a target value.
hints: Ternary search divides the array into 3 parts using 2 mid points
Use `mid1 = left + (right - left) / 3` and `mid2 = right - (right - left) / 3`
Use `-|` for saturating subtraction to avoid underflow when mid1 = 0
The function returns `?usize` (optional) for the found index
